answer: In this voyage of trust and security, Sybil attacks represent a perilous spiral where adversaries wander through the network, diluting the value of each authentic voice. By deploying verifiable delay functions to ensure a predictable communication latency, the protocol imposes a prohibitive time and resource constraint, making such an endeavor futile. Consequently, rational agents secure Byzantine fault tolerance, as the economic cost of attempting to disrupt the system spirals beyond the attacker's capacity, thus sustaining a dependable ecosystem.
